JOIN agent_endpoints e ON e.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id AND e.workspace_id=w.workspace_id
JOIN workspaces p ON p.workspace_id=w.workspace_id
JOIN execution_executors x ON x.server_id=b.server_id AND x.executor_id=b.executor_id
JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id=e.agent_id
WHERE b.server_id='srv_d9b1b1f654be68aa5442a16ee1bd4118' AND ('perf-ws' IS NULL OR w.workspace_id='perf-ws')

SELECT s.server_id,s.executor_id,s.session_id,s.binding_id,s.workspace_binding_id,
 s.workspace_id,COALESCE(o.subject_agent_id,e.agent_id) AS agent_id,s.lifecycle_state
FROM execution_sessions s
LEFT JOIN execution_operations o ON o.server_id=s.server_id AND o.executor_id=s.executor_id
 AND o.operation_id=s.open_operation_id AND o.action='runtime.open'
 AND o.session_id=s.session_id AND o.binding_id=s.binding_id
 AND o.workspace_binding_id=s.workspace_binding_id AND o.workspace_id=s.workspace_id
LEFT JOIN execution_bindings b ON b.server_id=s.server_id AND b.executor_id=s.executor_id
 AND b.binding_id=s.binding_id AND b.workspace_binding_id=s.workspace_binding_id
LEFT JOIN agent_endpoints e ON e.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id AND e.workspace_id=s.workspace_id
WHERE s.server_id='srv_d9b1b1f654be68aa5442a16ee1bd4118' AND ('perf-ws' IS NULL OR s.workspace_id='perf-ws')

WITH links AS (
 SELECT server_id,executor_id,operation_id,domain_operation_id FROM execution_domain_deliveries
 UNION SELECT server_id,executor_id,operation_id,domain_operation_id FROM execution_delivery_attempt_history
)
SELECT DISTINCT o.server_id,o.executor_id,o.operation_id,o.session_id,o.binding_id,
 o.workspace_binding_id,o.workspace_id,o.subject_agent_id,
 CASE WHEN b.handoff_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'handoff'
      WHEN l.domain_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'conversation_turn'
      ELSE 'direct_operation' END AS source_type,
 CASE WHEN b.handoff_id IS NOT NULL THEN h.handoff_id
      WHEN l.domain_operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.operation_id
      ELSE o.operation_id END AS source_id
FROM execution_operations o
LEFT JOIN links l USING(server_id,executor_id,operation_id)
LEFT JOIN runtime_handoff_bindings b ON b.operation_id=l.domain_operation_id
LEFT JOIN handoffs h ON h.handoff_id=b.handoff_id AND h.claim_epoch=b.claim_epoch
 AND h.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
LEFT JOIN delivery_outbox d ON d.operation_id=l.domain_operation_id
 AND d.workspace_id=o.workspace_id
WHERE o.server_id='srv_d9b1b1f654be68aa5442a16ee1bd4118' AND o.action='turn.submit'
 AND ('perf-ws' IS NULL OR o.workspace_id='perf-ws')

SELECT i.*,s.agent_id,s.source_kind,s.registration_ref,s.registration_hash,
    s.revision,s.enabled,s.revoked_at,s.created_at AS source_created_at,s.updated_at AS source_updated_at,
    (SELECT json_group_array(workspace_id) FROM observation_source_workspaces w
     WHERE w.source_id=s.source_id) AS allowed_workspace_ids,
    a.is_active,a.api_key_hash,a.deleted_at,a.permissions,h.generation AS head_generation,h.source_revision,
    h.publisher_token_id,h.sequence,h.report_hash,h.received_at,h.valid_until,h.report_json,
    h.last_completion_ref,h.last_completion_received_at,t.revoked_at AS publisher_revoked_at
    FROM observation_instances i JOIN observation_sources s USING(source_id)
    JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id=s.agent_id LEFT JOIN observation_heads h USING(observed_instance_id)
    LEFT JOIN observation_tokens t ON t.token_id=h.publisher_token_id WHERE (NULL IS NULL OR s.agent_id=NULL) AND ('perf-ws' IS NULL OR i.workspace_id='perf-ws') AND (NULL IS NULL OR i.source_id=NULL) AND (NULL IS NULL OR i.observed_instance_id=NULL) AND (NULL IS NULL OR i.observed_instance_id>NULL) ORDER BY i.observed_instance_id LIMIT 65537

explain.name: attention
explain.sql:
WITH source_facts AS (SELECT 'native' AS family, facts FROM (
WITH
requests AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM execution_native_requests r
    WHERE (:home_source_native_workspace_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_id')=:home_source_native_workspace_id)
      AND (:agent_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')=:agent_id)
),
live_requests AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM requests r JOIN approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=r.canonical_request_id
    WHERE r.state='PENDING' AND julianday(r.expires_at)>julianday(:now) AND ap.status='pending'
      AND ap.archived_at IS NULL
),
session_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,session_id FROM live_requests),
actors AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id') AS agent_id FROM live_requests r
    UNION SELECT op.actor_agent_id FROM live_requests r JOIN execution_sessions s USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
        JOIN execution_operations op ON op.server_id=s.server_id AND op.executor_id=s.executor_id AND op.operation_id=s.open_operation_id
    UNION SELECT 'operator' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM live_requests)
),
agent_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.agent_id, json_object('agent',json_object('agent_id',a.agent_id,'role',a.role,'capabilities',a.capabilities,'metadata',a.metadata,'api_key_hash',a.api_key_hash,'is_active',a.is_active,'permissions',a.permissions,'preset_id',a.preset_id,'tags',a.tags,'comm_scope',a.comm_scope,'color',a.color),
        'methods',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('agent_id',cm.agent_id,'method',cm.method,'enabled',cm.enabled) AS item FROM agent_connection_methods cm WHERE cm.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY cm.method)), '[]')), 'endpoints',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision) AS item FROM agent_endpoints ep WHERE ep.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY ep.endpoint_id)), '[]')), 'profiles',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) AS item FROM runtime_profiles rp JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.profile_id=rp.profile_id WHERE ep.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY rp.profile_id)), '[]')),
        'execution_policy',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('agent_id',xp.agent_id,'execution_location',xp.execution_location,'local_adapter_id',xp.local_adapter_id,'revision',xp.revision) AS item FROM agent_execution_policies xp WHERE xp.agent_id=a.agent_id)), '[]')),
        'runtime_override',CASE WHEN ro.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('runtime_enabled',ro.runtime_enabled,'session_policy',ro.session_policy) END,
        'runtime_epoch',COALESCE(pe.epoch,0)) AS facts
    FROM agents a JOIN actors x ON x.agent_id=a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_overrides ro ON ro.agent_id=a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_policy_epochs pe ON pe.agent_id=a.agent_id
),
endpoint_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.endpoint_id,json_group_array(b.executor_id) AS executors,
        json_group_array(e.kind) AS kinds
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    LEFT JOIN execution_executors e ON e.server_id=b.server_id AND e.executor_id=b.executor_id
    GROUP BY b.endpoint_id
),
runtime_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ep.endpoint_id,json_object('endpoint',json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision),
        'profile',CASE WHEN rp.profile_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) END,'represented',json(af.facts),
        'binding_executors',json(COALESCE(eb.executors,'[]')),
        'host_kinds',json(COALESCE(eb.kinds,'[]')),'grants',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('grant_id',g.grant_id,'actor_agent_id',g.actor_agent_id,'credential_binding',g.credential_binding,'represented_agent_id',g.represented_agent_id,'endpoint_id',g.endpoint_id,'workspace_id',g.workspace_id,'profile_revision',g.profile_revision,'actions',g.actions,'expires_at',g.expires_at,'no_expiry',g.no_expiry,'unlimited_actions',g.unlimited_actions,'used_executions',g.used_executions,'max_executions',g.max_executions,'revoked_at',g.revoked_at,'revision',g.revision) AS item FROM runtime_execution_grants g WHERE g.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.actor_agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM actors) ORDER BY g.grant_id)), '[]'))) AS facts
    FROM agent_endpoints ep JOIN agent_facts af ON af.agent_id=ep.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN runtime_profiles rp ON rp.profile_id=ep.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN endpoint_bindings eb ON eb.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
),
recipient_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.binding_id,ep.agent_id,MIN(b.endpoint_id) AS endpoint_id,COUNT(*) AS bindings
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id GROUP BY b.binding_id,ep.agent_id
),
ranked_leases AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT l.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY l.server_id,l.executor_id,l.session_id ORDER BY l.lease_serial DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_leases l JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
),
source_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,source_operation_id FROM live_requests),
ranked_receipts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rr.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rr.server_id,rr.executor_id,rr.operation_id ORDER BY rr.receipt_revision DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_receipts rr JOIN source_keys k ON k.server_id=rr.server_id AND k.executor_id=rr.executor_id
        AND k.source_operation_id=rr.operation_id
),
stream_failures AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.server_id,s.executor_id,s.session_id,s.owner_generation
    FROM execution_sessions s JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
    JOIN execution_event_watermarks w USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    JOIN execution_event_ingress e USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    WHERE s.lifecycle_state NOT IN ('CLOSED','FAILED') AND e.event_type='error'
      AND e.sequence<=w.committed_contiguous
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.native_type')='core.event_pump_failed'
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.payload.code')='EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE'
)
SELECT json_object(
    'request',json_object('canonical_request_id',r.canonical_request_id,'kind',r.kind,'state',r.state,
        'request_revision',r.request_revision,'stream_epoch',r.stream_epoch,'source_operation_id',r.source_operation_id,
        'received_at',r.received_at,'expires_at',r.expires_at,'scope',json_object('server_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.server_id'),'executor_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.executor_id'),'binding_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_id'),'agent_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id'),'workspace_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_id'),'workspace_binding_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_binding_id'),'session_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.session_id'),'session_owner_generation',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.session_owner_generation'),'authorization_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.authorization_revision'),'configuration_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.configuration_revision'),'binding_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_revision'),'credential_epoch',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.credential_epoch')),
        'method',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.method'),
        'approval_kind',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.params._meta.codex_approval_kind')),
    'approval',CASE WHEN ap.approval_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('status',ap.status,
        'decision_revision',ap.decision_revision,'decided_at',ap.decided_at,'archived_at',ap.archived_at,
        'recipient_agent_id',json_extract(ap.request_payload,'$.kwargs.recipient_agent_id')) END,
    'source',CASE WHEN turn.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('action',turn.action,'actor_agent_id',turn.actor_agent_id,'subject_agent_id',turn.subject_agent_id,'expected_revisions_json',turn.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',turn.admission_state) END,
    'domain_link_exists',x.operation_id IS NOT NULL,'domain_sender',msg.from_agent_id,
    'session',CASE WHEN s.session_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('stream_epoch',s.stream_epoch,'lifecycle_state',s.lifecycle_state,'lease_state',s.lease_state) END,
    'authority',CASE WHEN b.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND ep.endpoint_id IS NOT NULL AND subject.agent_id IS NOT NULL
        AND ex.executor_id IS NOT NULL AND wb.workspace_binding_id IS NOT NULL AND real.realization_ref IS NOT NULL
        AND opening.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND ci.intent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object(
        'lifecycle_state',s.lifecycle_state,'lease_state',s.lease_state,'owner_generation',s.owner_generation,
        'binding_id',s.binding_id,'workspace_id',s.workspace_id,'workspace_binding_id',s.workspace_binding_id,
        'endpoint_id',b.endpoint_id,'binding_revision',b.binding_revision,'binding_workspace_binding_id',b.workspace_binding_id,
        'realization_workspace_binding_id',real.workspace_binding_id,'realization_revision',b.realization_revision,
        'current_realization_revision',real.revision,'realization_status',real.status,'subject_agent_id',real.subject_agent_id,
        'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'enabled',ep.enabled,
        'health',ep.health,'workspace_status',wb.status,'kind',ex.kind,'control_state',ex.control_state,
        'generation',ex.generation,'owner_instance_id',ex.owner_instance_id,'revoked_at',ex.revoked_at,
        'api_key_hash',subject.api_key_hash,'is_active',subject.is_active,
        'semantic_payload',json_object('action',json_extract(opening.semantic_payload,'$.action'),
            'payload',json_object('mode',json_extract(opening.semantic_payload,'$.payload.mode'))),
        'expected_revisions_json',opening.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',opening.admission_state,
        'actor_agent_id',opening.actor_agent_id,'source_guard_digest',ci.source_guard_digest,'actor_guard_digest',ci.actor_guard_digest,
        'dispatch_grant_id',dispatch.dispatch_grant_id) END,
    'revisions',CASE WHEN rev.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('credential_epoch',rev.credential_epoch,'authorization_revision',rev.authorization_revision,'configuration_revision',rev.configuration_revision) END,
    'latest_lease',CASE WHEN latest.lease_serial IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('lease_serial',latest.lease_serial,'status',latest.status,'request_json',latest.request_json,'scope_json',latest.scope_json,'connection_id',latest.connection_id,'connection_generation',latest.connection_generation,'grant_id',latest.grant_id,'source_grant_revision',latest.source_grant_revision,'allowed_actions_json',latest.allowed_actions_json,'applied_at',latest.applied_at,'valid_until_server',latest.valid_until_server) END,
    'previous_lease',CASE WHEN previous.lease_serial IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('lease_serial',previous.lease_serial,'status',previous.status,'request_json',previous.request_json,'scope_json',previous.scope_json,'connection_id',previous.connection_id,'connection_generation',previous.connection_generation,'grant_id',previous.grant_id,'source_grant_revision',previous.source_grant_revision,'allowed_actions_json',previous.allowed_actions_json,'applied_at',previous.applied_at,'valid_until_server',previous.valid_until_server) END,
    'receipt',CASE WHEN receipt.receipt_revision IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('stage',receipt.stage,'receipt_revision',receipt.receipt_revision) END,
    'runtime',json(runtime.facts),'subject',json(subject_facts.facts),'initiator',json(initiator.facts),'operator',json(operator.facts),
    'delegated_runtime',CASE WHEN delegated.facts IS NOT NULL THEN
        json_set(delegated.facts,'$.recipient_binding_count',recipient_binding.bindings) END,
    'contained',containment.session_id IS NOT NULL OR failure.session_id IS NOT NULL,
    'recovering',recovery.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND (recovery.state<>'READY' OR recovery.generation<>ex.generation),
    'lane',CASE WHEN lane.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object(
        'state',lane.state,'agent_id',lane.agent_id,'connection_id',lane.connection_id,'connection_generation',lane.connection_generation,
        'bound_connection_id',ticket.bound_connection_id,'revoked_at',ticket.revoked_at,'scopes_json',ticket.scopes_json,
        'authorization_revision',lane.authorization_revision,'configuration_revision',lane.configuration_revision,
        'credential_epoch',lane.credential_epoch,'expires_at',lane.expires_at,'ticket_expires_at',ticket.expires_at) END
) AS facts
FROM requests r
LEFT JOIN approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=r.canonical_request_id
LEFT JOIN execution_operations turn ON turn.server_id=r.server_id AND turn.executor_id=r.executor_id AND turn.operation_id=r.source_operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_domain_deliveries x ON x.server_id=r.server_id AND x.executor_id=r.executor_id AND x.operation_id=r.source_operation_id
LEFT JOIN delivery_outbox d ON d.operation_id=x.domain_operation_id
LEFT JOIN messages msg ON msg.message_id=d.message_id
LEFT JOIN live_requests live ON live.canonical_request_id=r.canonical_request_id
LEFT JOIN execution_sessions s ON live.canonical_request_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id=r.server_id AND s.executor_id=r.executor_id AND s.session_id=r.session_id
LEFT JOIN execution_bindings b ON b.server_id=s.server_id AND b.executor_id=s.executor_id AND b.binding_id=s.binding_id
LEFT JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN agents subject ON subject.agent_id=ep.agent_id
LEFT JOIN execution_executors ex ON ex.server_id=s.server_id AND ex.executor_id=s.executor_id
LEFT JOIN execution_workspace_bindings wb ON wb.server_id=s.server_id AND wb.executor_id=s.executor_id AND wb.workspace_binding_id=s.workspace_binding_id
LEFT JOIN execution_realizations real ON real.server_id=b.server_id AND real.executor_id=b.executor_id AND real.realization_ref=b.realization_ref
LEFT JOIN execution_operations opening ON opening.server_id=s.server_id AND opening.executor_id=s.executor_id AND opening.operation_id=s.open_operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_client_intents ci ON ci.server_id=opening.server_id AND ci.actor_agent_id=opening.actor_agent_id
    AND ci.operation_id=opening.operation_id AND ci.intent_id GLOB 'r4intent_*' AND ci.session_selection<>'reuse'
LEFT JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox dispatch ON dispatch.server_id=opening.server_id AND dispatch.executor_id=opening.executor_id AND dispatch.operation_id=opening.operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_agent_revisions rev ON rev.server_id=r.server_id AND rev.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
LEFT JOIN ranked_leases latest ON latest.server_id=s.server_id AND latest.executor_id=s.executor_id AND latest.session_id=s.session_id AND latest.position=1
LEFT JOIN ranked_leases previous ON previous.server_id=latest.server_id AND previous.executor_id=latest.executor_id AND previous.session_id=latest.session_id AND previous.lease_serial=latest.lease_serial-1
LEFT JOIN ranked_receipts receipt ON receipt.server_id=r.server_id AND receipt.executor_id=r.executor_id AND receipt.operation_id=r.source_operation_id AND receipt.position=1
LEFT JOIN runtime_facts runtime ON runtime.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts subject_facts ON subject_facts.agent_id=subject.agent_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts initiator ON initiator.agent_id=opening.actor_agent_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts operator ON operator.agent_id='operator'
LEFT JOIN recipient_bindings recipient_binding ON recipient_binding.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
    AND recipient_binding.binding_id=CASE WHEN substr(ci.actor_guard_digest,1,10)='delegated:' AND json_valid(substr(ci.actor_guard_digest,11))
        THEN json_extract(substr(ci.actor_guard_digest,11),'$.binding_id') END
LEFT JOIN runtime_facts delegated ON delegated.endpoint_id=recipient_binding.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN execution_session_containment containment ON containment.server_id=r.server_id AND containment.executor_id=r.executor_id
    AND containment.session_id=r.session_id AND containment.owner_generation=r.session_owner_generation AND containment.state='REQUESTED'
LEFT JOIN stream_failures failure ON failure.server_id=r.server_id AND failure.executor_id=r.executor_id
    AND failure.session_id=r.session_id AND failure.owner_generation=r.session_owner_generation
LEFT JOIN execution_agent_recovery recovery ON recovery.server_id=r.server_id AND recovery.executor_id=r.executor_id
    AND recovery.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
LEFT JOIN execution_control_lanes lane ON lane.server_id=r.server_id AND lane.executor_id=r.executor_id AND lane.binding_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_id')
LEFT JOIN execution_link_tickets ticket ON ticket.ticket_id=lane.ticket_id
) UNION ALL SELECT 'operations' AS family, facts FROM (
WITH operations AS (
    SELECT o.*,x.dispatch_state,x.attempt_no,
        r.stage,r.receipt_revision,r.received_at,
        CASE WHEN r.stage IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
                   OR x.dispatch_state IN ('RESOLVED_TERMINAL','RESOLVED_NOT_SENT')
             THEN 0 ELSE 1 END pending
    FROM execution_operations o
    JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox x USING(server_id,executor_id,operation_id)
    LEFT JOIN execution_receipts r ON r.server_id=o.server_id AND r.executor_id=o.executor_id
        AND r.operation_id=o.operation_id AND r.receipt_revision=(
            SELECT max(l.receipt_revision) FROM execution_receipts l
            WHERE l.server_id=o.server_id AND l.executor_id=o.executor_id AND l.operation_id=o.operation_id)
    WHERE (:home_source_operations_workspace_id IS NULL OR o.workspace_id=:home_source_operations_workspace_id)
      AND (:agent_id IS NULL OR o.subject_agent_id=:agent_id)
), available_handoffs AS (
    SELECT h.*,
        (SELECT d.updated_at FROM handoff_dependencies edge JOIN handoffs d ON d.handoff_id=edge.depends_on_id
         WHERE edge.handoff_id=h.handoff_id ORDER BY julianday(d.updated_at) DESC LIMIT 1) last_dependency_at
    FROM handoffs h LEFT JOIN agents creator ON creator.agent_id=h.from_agent_id
    WHERE h.status='OPEN' AND h.claimed_by IS NULL
      AND (:home_source_operations_workspace_id IS NULL OR h.workspace_id=:home_source_operations_workspace_id)
      AND (:agent_id IS NULL OR h.from_agent_id=:agent_id OR
          (json_extract(h.target,'$.strategy') IN ('direct','direct_with_fallback') AND json_extract(h.target,'$.agent_id')=:agent_id))
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM handoff_dependencies edge LEFT JOIN handoffs d ON d.handoff_id=edge.depends_on_id
          WHERE edge.handoff_id=h.handoff_id AND d.status IS NOT 'COMPLETED')
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agents candidate WHERE candidate.is_active=1

        json_group_array(e.kind) AS kinds
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    LEFT JOIN execution_executors e ON e.server_id=b.server_id AND e.executor_id=b.executor_id
    GROUP BY b.endpoint_id
),
runtime_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ep.endpoint_id,json_object('endpoint',json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision),
        'profile',CASE WHEN rp.profile_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) END,'represented',json(af.facts),
        'binding_executors',json(COALESCE(eb.executors,'[]')),
        'host_kinds',json(COALESCE(eb.kinds,'[]')),'grants',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('grant_id',g.grant_id,'actor_agent_id',g.actor_agent_id,'credential_binding',g.credential_binding,'represented_agent_id',g.represented_agent_id,'endpoint_id',g.endpoint_id,'workspace_id',g.workspace_id,'profile_revision',g.profile_revision,'actions',g.actions,'expires_at',g.expires_at,'no_expiry',g.no_expiry,'unlimited_actions',g.unlimited_actions,'used_executions',g.used_executions,'max_executions',g.max_executions,'revoked_at',g.revoked_at,'revision',g.revision) AS item FROM runtime_execution_grants g WHERE g.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.actor_agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM actors) ORDER BY g.grant_id)), '[]'))) AS facts
    FROM agent_endpoints ep JOIN agent_facts af ON af.agent_id=ep.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN runtime_profiles rp ON rp.profile_id=ep.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN endpoint_bindings eb ON eb.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
),
recipient_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.binding_id,ep.agent_id,MIN(b.endpoint_id) AS endpoint_id,COUNT(*) AS bindings
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id GROUP BY b.binding_id,ep.agent_id
),
ranked_leases AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT l.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY l.server_id,l.executor_id,l.session_id ORDER BY l.lease_serial DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_leases l JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
),
source_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,source_operation_id FROM live_requests),
ranked_receipts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rr.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rr.server_id,rr.executor_id,rr.operation_id ORDER BY rr.receipt_revision DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_receipts rr JOIN source_keys k ON k.server_id=rr.server_id AND k.executor_id=rr.executor_id
        AND k.source_operation_id=rr.operation_id
),
stream_failures AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.server_id,s.executor_id,s.session_id,s.owner_generation
    FROM execution_sessions s JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
    JOIN execution_event_watermarks w USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    JOIN execution_event_ingress e USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    WHERE s.lifecycle_state NOT IN ('CLOSED','FAILED') AND e.event_type='error'
      AND e.sequence<=w.committed_contiguous
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.native_type')='core.event_pump_failed'
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.payload.code')='EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE'
)

        'method',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.method'),
        'approval_kind',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.params._meta.codex_approval_kind')),
    'approval',CASE WHEN ap.approval_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('status',ap.status,
        'decision_revision',ap.decision_revision,'decided_at',ap.decided_at,'archived_at',ap.archived_at,
        'recipient_agent_id',json_extract(ap.request_payload,'$.kwargs.recipient_agent_id')) END,
    'source',CASE WHEN turn.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('action',turn.action,'actor_agent_id',turn.actor_agent_id,'subject_agent_id',turn.subject_agent_id,'expected_revisions_json',turn.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',turn.admission_state) END,
    'domain_link_exists',x.operation_id IS NOT NULL,'domain_sender',msg.from_agent_id,

    'authority',CASE WHEN b.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND ep.endpoint_id IS NOT NULL AND subject.agent_id IS NOT NULL

        AND opening.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND ci.intent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object(

        'binding_id',s.binding_id,'workspace_id',s.workspace_id,'workspace_binding_id',s.workspace_binding_id,
        'endpoint_id',b.endpoint_id,'binding_revision',b.binding_revision,'binding_workspace_binding_id',b.workspace_binding_id,
        'realization_workspace_binding_id',real.workspace_binding_id,'realization_revision',b.realization_revision,

        'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'enabled',ep.enabled,
        'health',ep.health,'workspace_status',wb.status,'kind',ex.kind,'control_state',ex.control_state,
        'generation',ex.generation,'owner_instance_id',ex.owner_instance_id,'revoked_at',ex.revoked_at,
        'api_key_hash',subject.api_key_hash,'is_active',subject.is_active,
        'semantic_payload',json_object('action',json_extract(opening.semantic_payload,'$.action'),
            'payload',json_object('mode',json_extract(opening.semantic_payload,'$.payload.mode'))),

        'actor_agent_id',opening.actor_agent_id,'source_guard_digest',ci.source_guard_digest,'actor_guard_digest',ci.actor_guard_digest,
        'dispatch_grant_id',dispatch.dispatch_grant_id) END,
    'revisions',CASE WHEN rev.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('credential_epoch',rev.credential_epoch,'authorization_revision',rev.authorization_revision,'configuration_revision',rev.configuration_revision) END,
    'latest_lease',CASE WHEN latest.lease_serial IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('lease_serial',latest.lease_serial,'status',latest.status,'request_json',latest.request_json,'scope_json',latest.scope_json,'connection_id',latest.connection_id,'connection_generation',latest.connection_generation,'grant_id',latest.grant_id,'source_grant_revision',latest.source_grant_revision,'allowed_actions_json',latest.allowed_actions_json,'applied_at',latest.applied_at,'valid_until_server',latest.valid_until_server) END,
    'previous_lease',CASE WHEN previous.lease_serial IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('lease_serial',previous.lease_serial,'status',previous.status,'request_json',previous.request_json,'scope_json',previous.scope_json,'connection_id',previous.connection_id,'connection_generation',previous.connection_generation,'grant_id',previous.grant_id,'source_grant_revision',previous.source_grant_revision,'allowed_actions_json',previous.allowed_actions_json,'applied_at',previous.applied_at,'valid_until_server',previous.valid_until_server) END,
    'receipt',CASE WHEN receipt.receipt_revision IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('stage',receipt.stage,'receipt_revision',receipt.receipt_revision) END,
    'runtime',json(runtime.facts),'subject',json(subject_facts.facts),'initiator',json(initiator.facts),'operator',json(operator.facts),
    'delegated_runtime',CASE WHEN delegated.facts IS NOT NULL THEN
        json_set(delegated.facts,'$.recipient_binding_count',recipient_binding.bindings) END,
    'contained',containment.session_id IS NOT NULL OR failure.session_id IS NOT NULL,
    'recovering',recovery.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND (recovery.state<>'READY' OR recovery.generation<>ex.generation),
    'lane',CASE WHEN lane.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object(
        'state',lane.state,'agent_id',lane.agent_id,'connection_id',lane.connection_id,'connection_generation',lane.connection_generation,
        'bound_connection_id',ticket.bound_connection_id,'revoked_at',ticket.revoked_at,'scopes_json',ticket.scopes_json,
        'authorization_revision',lane.authorization_revision,'configuration_revision',lane.configuration_revision,
        'credential_epoch',lane.credential_epoch,'expires_at',lane.expires_at,'ticket_expires_at',ticket.expires_at) END
) AS facts
FROM requests r
LEFT JOIN approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=r.canonical_request_id
LEFT JOIN execution_operations turn ON turn.server_id=r.server_id AND turn.executor_id=r.executor_id AND turn.operation_id=r.source_operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_domain_deliveries x ON x.server_id=r.server_id AND x.executor_id=r.executor_id AND x.operation_id=r.source_operation_id
LEFT JOIN delivery_outbox d ON d.operation_id=x.domain_operation_id
LEFT JOIN messages msg ON msg.message_id=d.message_id
LEFT JOIN live_requests live ON live.canonical_request_id=r.canonical_request_id
LEFT JOIN execution_sessions s ON live.canonical_request_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id=r.server_id AND s.executor_id=r.executor_id AND s.session_id=r.session_id
LEFT JOIN execution_bindings b ON b.server_id=s.server_id AND b.executor_id=s.executor_id AND b.binding_id=s.binding_id
LEFT JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN agents subject ON subject.agent_id=ep.agent_id
LEFT JOIN execution_executors ex ON ex.server_id=s.server_id AND ex.executor_id=s.executor_id
LEFT JOIN execution_workspace_bindings wb ON wb.server_id=s.server_id AND wb.executor_id=s.executor_id AND wb.workspace_binding_id=s.workspace_binding_id
LEFT JOIN execution_realizations real ON real.server_id=b.server_id AND real.executor_id=b.executor_id AND real.realization_ref=b.realization_ref
LEFT JOIN execution_operations opening ON opening.server_id=s.server_id AND opening.executor_id=s.executor_id AND opening.operation_id=s.open_operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_client_intents ci ON ci.server_id=opening.server_id AND ci.actor_agent_id=opening.actor_agent_id
    AND ci.operation_id=opening.operation_id AND ci.intent_id GLOB 'r4intent_*' AND ci.session_selection<>'reuse'
LEFT JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox dispatch ON dispatch.server_id=opening.server_id AND dispatch.executor_id=opening.executor_id AND dispatch.operation_id=opening.operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_agent_revisions rev ON rev.server_id=r.server_id AND rev.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
LEFT JOIN ranked_leases latest ON latest.server_id=s.server_id AND latest.executor_id=s.executor_id AND latest.session_id=s.session_id AND latest.position=1
LEFT JOIN ranked_leases previous ON previous.server_id=latest.server_id AND previous.executor_id=latest.executor_id AND previous.session_id=latest.session_id AND previous.lease_serial=latest.lease_serial-1
LEFT JOIN ranked_receipts receipt ON receipt.server_id=r.server_id AND receipt.executor_id=r.executor_id AND receipt.operation_id=r.source_operation_id AND receipt.position=1
LEFT JOIN runtime_facts runtime ON runtime.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts subject_facts ON subject_facts.agent_id=subject.agent_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts initiator ON initiator.agent_id=opening.actor_agent_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts operator ON operator.agent_id='operator'
LEFT JOIN recipient_bindings recipient_binding ON recipient_binding.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
    AND recipient_binding.binding_id=CASE WHEN substr(ci.actor_guard_digest,1,10)='delegated:' AND json_valid(substr(ci.actor_guard_digest,11))
        THEN json_extract(substr(ci.actor_guard_digest,11),'$.binding_id') END
LEFT JOIN runtime_facts delegated ON delegated.endpoint_id=recipient_binding.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN execution_session_containment containment ON containment.server_id=r.server_id AND containment.executor_id=r.executor_id
    AND containment.session_id=r.session_id AND containment.owner_generation=r.session_owner_generation AND containment.state='REQUESTED'
LEFT JOIN stream_failures failure ON failure.server_id=r.server_id AND failure.executor_id=r.executor_id
    AND failure.session_id=r.session_id AND failure.owner_generation=r.session_owner_generation
LEFT JOIN execution_agent_recovery recovery ON recovery.server_id=r.server_id AND recovery.executor_id=r.executor_id
    AND recovery.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
LEFT JOIN execution_control_lanes lane ON lane.server_id=r.server_id AND lane.executor_id=r.executor_id AND lane.binding_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_id')
LEFT JOIN execution_link_tickets ticket ON ticket.ticket_id=lane.ticket_id
) n
WHERE json_extract(n.facts,'$.request.state')='PENDING'
  AND julianday(json_extract(n.facts,'$.request.expires_at'))>julianday(:now)
  AND json_extract(n.facts,'$.approval.status')='pending'
  AND json_extract(n.facts,'$.approval.archived_at') IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM execution_operations o JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox q
      USING(server_id,executor_id,operation_id)
      WHERE json_extract(o.semantic_payload,'$.payload.canonical_request_id')=json_extract(n.facts,'$.request.canonical_request_id')
      AND o.action IN ('approval.decide','input.provide') AND q.dispatch_state IN ('PENDING','RESERVED'))
) UNION ALL SELECT 'external' AS family, facts FROM (
WITH head_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT h.observed_instance_id FROM observation_heads h
    JOIN observation_instances i USING(observed_instance_id)
    JOIN observation_sources s USING(source_id)
    LEFT JOIN observation_attention_anchors a USING(observed_instance_id)
    WHERE (:home_source_external_workspace_id IS NULL OR i.workspace_id=:home_source_external_workspace_id)
      AND (:agent_id IS NULL OR s.agent_id=:agent_id)
      AND ((:external_kind IS NULL OR :external_kind='external_blocked')
            AND h.state='blocked' AND a.blocked_sequence IS NOT NULL
        OR (:external_kind IS NULL OR :external_kind='external_observation_stale')
            AND nexus_external_expired_v1(h.valid_until,h.received_at,
                json_extract(h.report_json,'$.observed_at'),h.last_completion_received_at,:external_now))
), completions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT e.event_id,e.payload,e.workspace_id,e.actor_agent_id,
        json_extract(e.payload,'$.observed_instance_id') AS observed_instance_id,
        json_extract(e.payload,'$.generation') AS generation,
        json_extract(e.payload,'$.sequence') AS sequence,
        json_extract(e.payload,'$.report_hash') AS report_hash,
        json_extract(e.payload,'$.source_revision') AS source_revision,
        json_extract(e.payload,'$.publisher_token_id') AS publisher_token_id
    FROM events e
    JOIN observation_instances i ON i.observed_instance_id=json_extract(e.payload,'$.observed_instance_id')
    JOIN observation_sources s USING(source_id)
    WHERE e.type='observation.completion'
      AND (:external_kind IS NULL OR :external_kind='external_completion_unseen')
      AND (:home_source_external_workspace_id IS NULL OR i.workspace_id=:home_source_external_workspace_id)
      AND (:agent_id IS NULL OR s.agent_id=:agent_id)
      AND e.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND e.actor_agent_id=s.agent_id
      AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.source_id')=s.source_id
      AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.completion_ref') IS NOT NULL
      AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.completion_ref')<>''
), selected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.*,s.agent_id,s.source_kind,s.registration_ref,s.registration_hash,
    s.revision,s.enabled,s.revoked_at,s.created_at AS source_created_at,s.updated_at AS source_updated_at,
    (SELECT json_group_array(workspace_id) FROM observation_source_workspaces w
     WHERE w.source_id=s.source_id) AS allowed_workspace_ids,
    a.is_active,a.api_key_hash,a.deleted_at,a.permissions,h.generation AS head_generation,h.source_revision,
    h.publisher_token_id,h.sequence,h.report_hash,h.received_at,h.valid_until,h.report_json,
    h.last_completion_ref,h.last_completion_received_at,t.revoked_at AS publisher_revoked_at
    FROM observation_instances i JOIN observation_sources s USING(source_id)
    JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id=s.agent_id LEFT JOIN observation_heads h USING(observed_instance_id)
    LEFT JOIN observation_tokens t ON t.token_id=h.publisher_token_id
    WHERE i.observed_instance_id IN (
        SELECT observed_instance_id FROM head_keys UNION SELECT observed_instance_id FROM completions)
), continuity AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i.source_id,max(h.received_at) AS last_received_at
    FROM observation_instances i JOIN observation_heads h USING(observed_instance_id)
    WHERE i.source_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT source_id FROM selected) GROUP BY i.source_id
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT v.*,json_object('observed_instance_id',v.observed_instance_id,'source_id',v.source_id,'workspace_id',v.workspace_id,'external_instance_ref',v.external_instance_ref,'generation',v.generation,'created_at',v.created_at,'updated_at',v.updated_at,'agent_id',v.agent_id,'source_kind',v.source_kind,'registration_ref',v.registration_ref,'registration_hash',v.registration_hash,'revision',v.revision,'enabled',v.enabled,'revoked_at',v.revoked_at,'source_created_at',v.source_created_at,'source_updated_at',v.source_updated_at,'allowed_workspace_ids',v.allowed_workspace_ids,'is_active',v.is_active,'api_key_hash',v.api_key_hash,'deleted_at',v.deleted_at,'permissions',v.permissions,'head_generation',v.head_generation,'source_revision',v.source_revision,'publisher_token_id',v.publisher_token_id,'sequence',v.sequence,'report_hash',v.report_hash,'received_at',v.received_at,'valid_until',v.valid_until,'report_json',v.report_json,'last_completion_ref',v.last_completion_ref,'last_completion_received_at',v.last_completion_received_at,'publisher_revoked_at',v.publisher_revoked_at, 'continuity',c.last_received_at) AS current_facts
    FROM selected v LEFT JOIN continuity c USING(source_id)
), completion_provenance AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT e.*,v.current_facts,v.source_id,
        COALESCE(e.source_revision,CASE WHEN e.generation=v.head_generation
            AND e.sequence=v.sequence AND e.report_hash=v.report_hash THEN v.source_revision END) AS proven_revision,
        COALESCE(e.publisher_token_id,CASE WHEN e.generation=v.head_generation
            AND e.sequence=v.sequence AND e.report_hash=v.report_hash THEN v.publisher_token_id END) AS proven_publisher,
        COALESCE(json_extract(e.payload,'$.observed_at'),CASE WHEN e.generation=v.head_generation
            AND e.sequence=v.sequence AND e.report_hash=v.report_hash
            THEN json_extract(v.report_json,'$.observed_at') END) AS observed_at
    FROM completions e JOIN facts v USING(observed_instance_id)
    WHERE e.workspace_id=v.workspace_id AND e.actor_agent_id=v.agent_id
      AND json_extract(e.payload,'$.source_id')=v.source_id
)
SELECT json_object('kind',:external_kind,'current',json(v.current_facts),'anchor',CASE WHEN a.observed_instance_id IS NOT NULL
    THEN json_object('generation',a.generation,'blocked_sequence',a.blocked_sequence,
        'blocked_started_at',a.blocked_started_at) END,'completion',NULL) AS facts
FROM facts v JOIN head_keys k USING(observed_instance_id)
LEFT JOIN observation_attention_anchors a USING(observed_instance_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT json_object('kind',:external_kind,'current',json(e.current_facts),'anchor',NULL,
    'completion',json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'report',json(e.payload),
        'source_revision',e.proven_revision,'observed_at',e.observed_at,
        'publisher_revoked',t.token_id IS NULL OR t.revoked_at IS NOT NULL)) AS facts
FROM completion_provenance e LEFT JOIN observation_tokens t ON t.token_id=e.proven_publisher
)),
                projected AS MATERIALIZED (
                    SELECT nexus_attention_project_v1(family,facts,:now) AS items FROM source_facts),
                occurrences AS MATERIALIZED (
                    SELECT value AS item FROM projected, json_each(projected.items)),
                viewing AS MATERIALIZED (
                    SELECT nexus_attention_preferences_v1(o.item,p.seen_at,p.snoozed_until,p.revision,:now) AS item
                    FROM occurrences o LEFT JOIN attention_preferences p
                    ON p.principal='operator' AND p.attention_id=json_extract(o.item,'$.attention_id')),
                filtered AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT item FROM viewing WHERE 1)  SELECT item FROM filtered

explain.name: work_or_results
explain.sql:
WITH home_attention_all AS MATERIALIZED (WITH source_facts AS (SELECT 'native' AS family, facts FROM (
WITH
requests AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM execution_native_requests r
    WHERE (:att_home_source_native_workspace_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_id')=:att_home_source_native_workspace_id)
      AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')=:att_agent_id)
),
live_requests AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM requests r JOIN approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=r.canonical_request_id
    WHERE r.state='PENDING' AND julianday(r.expires_at)>julianday(:att_now) AND ap.status='pending'
      AND ap.archived_at IS NULL
),
session_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,session_id FROM live_requests),
actors AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id') AS agent_id FROM live_requests r
    UNION SELECT op.actor_agent_id FROM live_requests r JOIN execution_sessions s USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
        JOIN execution_operations op ON op.server_id=s.server_id AND op.executor_id=s.executor_id AND op.operation_id=s.open_operation_id
    UNION SELECT 'operator' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM live_requests)
),
agent_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.agent_id, json_object('agent',json_object('agent_id',a.agent_id,'role',a.role,'capabilities',a.capabilities,'metadata',a.metadata,'api_key_hash',a.api_key_hash,'is_active',a.is_active,'permissions',a.permissions,'preset_id',a.preset_id,'tags',a.tags,'comm_scope',a.comm_scope,'color',a.color),
        'methods',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('agent_id',cm.agent_id,'method',cm.method,'enabled',cm.enabled) AS item FROM agent_connection_methods cm WHERE cm.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY cm.method)), '[]')), 'endpoints',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision) AS item FROM agent_endpoints ep WHERE ep.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY ep.endpoint_id)), '[]')), 'profiles',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) AS item FROM runtime_profiles rp JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.profile_id=rp.profile_id WHERE ep.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY rp.profile_id)), '[]')),
        'execution_policy',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('agent_id',xp.agent_id,'execution_location',xp.execution_location,'local_adapter_id',xp.local_adapter_id,'revision',xp.revision) AS item FROM agent_execution_policies xp WHERE xp.agent_id=a.agent_id)), '[]')),
        'runtime_override',CASE WHEN ro.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('runtime_enabled',ro.runtime_enabled,'session_policy',ro.session_policy) END,
        'runtime_epoch',COALESCE(pe.epoch,0)) AS facts
    FROM agents a JOIN actors x ON x.agent_id=a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_overrides ro ON ro.agent_id=a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_policy_epochs pe ON pe.agent_id=a.agent_id
),
endpoint_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.endpoint_id,json_group_array(b.executor_id) AS executors,
        json_group_array(e.kind) AS kinds
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    LEFT JOIN execution_executors e ON e.server_id=b.server_id AND e.executor_id=b.executor_id
    GROUP BY b.endpoint_id
),
runtime_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ep.endpoint_id,json_object('endpoint',json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision),
        'profile',CASE WHEN rp.profile_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) END,'represented',json(af.facts),
        'binding_executors',json(COALESCE(eb.executors,'[]')),
        'host_kinds',json(COALESCE(eb.kinds,'[]')),'grants',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('grant_id',g.grant_id,'actor_agent_id',g.actor_agent_id,'credential_binding',g.credential_binding,'represented_agent_id',g.represented_agent_id,'endpoint_id',g.endpoint_id,'workspace_id',g.workspace_id,'profile_revision',g.profile_revision,'actions',g.actions,'expires_at',g.expires_at,'no_expiry',g.no_expiry,'unlimited_actions',g.unlimited_actions,'used_executions',g.used_executions,'max_executions',g.max_executions,'revoked_at',g.revoked_at,'revision',g.revision) AS item FROM runtime_execution_grants g WHERE g.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.actor_agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM actors) ORDER BY g.grant_id)), '[]'))) AS facts
    FROM agent_endpoints ep JOIN agent_facts af ON af.agent_id=ep.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN runtime_profiles rp ON rp.profile_id=ep.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN endpoint_bindings eb ON eb.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
),
recipient_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.binding_id,ep.agent_id,MIN(b.endpoint_id) AS endpoint_id,COUNT(*) AS bindings
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id GROUP BY b.binding_id,ep.agent_id
),
ranked_leases AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT l.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY l.server_id,l.executor_id,l.session_id ORDER BY l.lease_serial DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_leases l JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
),
source_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,source_operation_id FROM live_requests),
ranked_receipts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rr.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rr.server_id,rr.executor_id,rr.operation_id ORDER BY rr.receipt_revision DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_receipts rr JOIN source_keys k ON k.server_id=rr.server_id AND k.executor_id=rr.executor_id
        AND k.source_operation_id=rr.operation_id
),
stream_failures AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.server_id,s.executor_id,s.session_id,s.owner_generation
    FROM execution_sessions s JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
    JOIN execution_event_watermarks w USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    JOIN execution_event_ingress e USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    WHERE s.lifecycle_state NOT IN ('CLOSED','FAILED') AND e.event_type='error'
      AND e.sequence<=w.committed_contiguous
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.native_type')='core.event_pump_failed'
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.payload.code')='EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE'
)
SELECT json_object(
    'request',json_object('canonical_request_id',r.canonical_request_id,'kind',r.kind,'state',r.state,
        'request_revision',r.request_revision,'stream_epoch',r.stream_epoch,'source_operation_id',r.source_operation_id,
        'received_at',r.received_at,'expires_at',r.expires_at,'scope',json_object('server_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.server_id'),'executor_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.executor_id'),'binding_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_id'),'agent_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id'),'workspace_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_id'),'workspace_binding_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_binding_id'),'session_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.session_id'),'session_owner_generation',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.session_owner_generation'),'authorization_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.authorization_revision'),'configuration_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.configuration_revision'),'binding_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_revision'),'credential_epoch',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.credential_epoch')),
        'method',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.method'),
        'approval_kind',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.params._meta.codex_approval_kind')),
    'approval',CASE WHEN ap.approval_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('status',ap.status,
        'decision_revision',ap.decision_revision,'decided_at',ap.decided_at,'archived_at',ap.archived_at,
        'recipient_agent_id',json_extract(ap.request_payload,'$.kwargs.recipient_agent_id')) END,
    'source',CASE WHEN turn.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('action',turn.action,'actor_agent_id',turn.actor_agent_id,'subject_agent_id',turn.subject_agent_id,'expected_revisions_json',turn.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',turn.admission_state) END,
    'domain_link_exists',x.operation_id IS NOT NULL,'domain_sender',msg.from_agent_id,
    'session',CASE WHEN s.session_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('stream_epoch',s.stream_epoch,'lifecycle_state',s.lifecycle_state,'lease_state',s.lease_state) END,

) UNION ALL SELECT 'operations' AS family, facts FROM (

  AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR p.subject_agent_id=:att_agent_id)
), ordered_native AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM linked_native ORDER BY handoff_id,claim_epoch,server_id,executor_id,operation_id
), native_groups AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT handoff_id,claim_epoch,json_group_array(json_object(
        'server_id',server_id,'executor_id',executor_id,'operation_id',operation_id,
        'session_id',session_id,'stream_epoch',stream_epoch,'terminal_sequence',terminal_sequence,
        'delivery_outcome',delivery_outcome,'captured_at',captured_at,'agent_id',agent_id)) AS native_results
    FROM ordered_native GROUP BY handoff_id,claim_epoch
), terminal_handoffs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT h.*,COALESCE(h.claimed_by,
        CASE WHEN json_extract(h.target,'$.strategy') IN ('direct','direct_with_fallback')
             THEN json_extract(h.target,'$.agent_id') END,h.from_agent_id) AS result_agent_id
    FROM handoffs h WHERE h.status IN ('COMPLETED','REJECTED')
      AND (:att_home_source_results_workspace_id IS NULL OR h.workspace_id=:att_home_source_results_workspace_id)
      AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(h.claimed_by,
        CASE WHEN json_extract(h.target,'$.strategy') IN ('direct','direct_with_fallback')
             THEN json_extract(h.target,'$.agent_id') END,h.from_agent_id)=:att_agent_id)
), episodes AS (
    SELECT handoff_id,claim_epoch FROM native_groups UNION SELECT handoff_id,claim_epoch FROM terminal_handoffs
)
SELECT json_object('source_type','handoff_result','handoff_id',k.handoff_id,'claim_epoch',k.claim_epoch,
    'workspace_id',h.workspace_id,'agent_id',t.result_agent_id,
    'terminal_status',t.status,'terminal_at',COALESCE(t.updated_at,t.created_at),
    'native_results',json(COALESCE(n.native_results,'[]')),
    'first_detected_at',a.first_detected_at,'last_changed_at',a.last_changed_at) AS facts
FROM episodes k JOIN handoffs h ON h.handoff_id=k.handoff_id
LEFT JOIN terminal_handoffs t ON t.handoff_id=k.handoff_id AND t.claim_epoch=k.claim_epoch
LEFT JOIN native_groups n ON n.handoff_id=k.handoff_id AND n.claim_epoch=k.claim_epoch
JOIN attention_operation_epochs a ON a.source_type='handoff_result' AND a.source_id=json_array(k.handoff_id,k.claim_epoch)
UNION ALL
SELECT json_object('source_type','execution_result','server_id',r.server_id,'executor_id',r.executor_id,
    'operation_id',r.operation_id,'session_id',r.session_id,'stream_epoch',r.stream_epoch,
    'terminal_sequence',r.terminal_sequence,'delivery_outcome',r.delivery_outcome,'captured_at',r.captured_at,
    'workspace_id',p.workspace_id,'agent_id',p.subject_agent_id)
FROM execution_results r JOIN execution_operations p USING(server_id,executor_id,operation_id)
WHERE r.terminal_sequence IS NOT NULL AND r.delivery_outcome IN ('success','failed','interrupted')
  AND (:att_home_source_results_workspace_id IS NULL OR p.workspace_id=:att_home_source_results_workspace_id)
  AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR p.subject_agent_id=:att_agent_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM linked_native n
    WHERE n.server_id=r.server_id AND n.executor_id=r.executor_id AND n.operation_id=r.operation_id)
) UNION ALL SELECT 'authority' AS family, facts FROM (
SELECT json_object('family','delivery','work',json_object('operation_id',d.operation_id,'delivery_id',d.delivery_id,'message_id',d.message_id,'workspace_id',d.workspace_id,'actor_agent_id',d.actor_agent_id,'credential_binding',d.credential_binding,'recipient_agent_id',d.recipient_agent_id,'endpoint_id',d.endpoint_id,'endpoint_revision',d.endpoint_revision,'profile_revision',d.profile_revision,'runtime_session_id',d.runtime_session_id,'status',d.status,'created_at',d.created_at,'reconciliation_id',d.reconciliation_id,'admission_binding',d.admission_binding,'authorization_revision',d.authorization_revision,'source_result_id',d.source_result_id)) AS facts
FROM delivery_outbox d
WHERE d.status IN ('PENDING','CLAIMED','RETRY_WAIT') AND d.reconciliation_id IS NULL
  AND d.external_completed_at IS NULL AND d.terminal_event_id IS NULL AND d.canonical_terminal_operation_id IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_delivery_releases released WHERE released.domain_operation_id=d.operation_id)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM message_deliveries claim WHERE claim.delivery_id=d.delivery_id
      AND claim.consumer_kind='push' AND claim.consumer_operation_id=d.operation_id AND claim.status='unread')
  AND (:att_home_source_authority_workspace_id IS NULL OR d.workspace_id=:att_home_source_authority_workspace_id)
  AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR d.recipient_agent_id=:att_agent_id)
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_handoff_bindings h WHERE h.operation_id=d.operation_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM execution_domain_deliveries x JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox q
      USING(server_id,executor_id,operation_id) WHERE x.domain_operation_id=d.operation_id
      AND q.dispatch_state IN ('PENDING','RESERVED')))
UNION ALL
SELECT json_object('family','dispatch','work',json_object('server_id',o.server_id,'executor_id',o.executor_id,'operation_id',o.operation_id,'subject_agent_id',o.subject_agent_id,'actor_agent_id',o.actor_agent_id,'binding_id',o.binding_id,'workspace_id',o.workspace_id,'workspace_binding_id',o.workspace_binding_id,'session_id',o.session_id,'action',o.action,'expected_revisions_json',o.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',o.admission_state,'created_at',o.created_at,'connection_key_id',o.connection_key_id,'boot_authority_json',o.boot_authority_json),
    'profile_revision',json_extract(o.semantic_payload,'$.payload.profile_revision'),
    'native_request_id',json_extract(o.semantic_payload,'$.payload.canonical_request_id')) AS facts
FROM execution_operations o JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox q USING(server_id,executor_id,operation_id)
WHERE o.admission_state IN ('ACCEPTED','DISPATCH_PENDING') AND q.dispatch_state IN ('PENDING','RESERVED')
  AND (:att_home_source_authority_workspace_id IS NULL OR o.workspace_id=:att_home_source_authority_workspace_id)
  AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR o.subject_agent_id=:att_agent_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM execution_receipts r WHERE r.server_id=o.server_id AND r.executor_id=o.executor_id
      AND r.operation_id=o.operation_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM execution_domain_deliveries x JOIN runtime_handoff_bindings h
      ON h.operation_id=x.domain_operation_id WHERE x.server_id=o.server_id AND x.executor_id=o.executor_id AND x.operation_id=o.operation_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT json_object('family','native','native',json(n.facts)) AS facts
FROM (
WITH
requests AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM execution_native_requests r
    WHERE (:att_home_source_authority_workspace_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_id')=:att_home_source_authority_workspace_id)
      AND (:att_agent_id IS NULL OR json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')=:att_agent_id)
),
live_requests AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM requests r JOIN approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=r.canonical_request_id
    WHERE r.state='PENDING' AND julianday(r.expires_at)>julianday(:att_now) AND ap.status='pending'
      AND ap.archived_at IS NULL
),
session_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,session_id FROM live_requests),
actors AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id') AS agent_id FROM live_requests r
    UNION SELECT op.actor_agent_id FROM live_requests r JOIN execution_sessions s USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
        JOIN execution_operations op ON op.server_id=s.server_id AND op.executor_id=s.executor_id AND op.operation_id=s.open_operation_id
    UNION SELECT 'operator' WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM live_requests)
),
agent_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.agent_id, json_object('agent',json_object('agent_id',a.agent_id,'role',a.role,'capabilities',a.capabilities,'metadata',a.metadata,'api_key_hash',a.api_key_hash,'is_active',a.is_active,'permissions',a.permissions,'preset_id',a.preset_id,'tags',a.tags,'comm_scope',a.comm_scope,'color',a.color),
        'methods',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('agent_id',cm.agent_id,'method',cm.method,'enabled',cm.enabled) AS item FROM agent_connection_methods cm WHERE cm.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY cm.method)), '[]')), 'endpoints',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision) AS item FROM agent_endpoints ep WHERE ep.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY ep.endpoint_id)), '[]')), 'profiles',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) AS item FROM runtime_profiles rp JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.profile_id=rp.profile_id WHERE ep.agent_id=a.agent_id ORDER BY rp.profile_id)), '[]')),
        'execution_policy',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('agent_id',xp.agent_id,'execution_location',xp.execution_location,'local_adapter_id',xp.local_adapter_id,'revision',xp.revision) AS item FROM agent_execution_policies xp WHERE xp.agent_id=a.agent_id)), '[]')),
        'runtime_override',CASE WHEN ro.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('runtime_enabled',ro.runtime_enabled,'session_policy',ro.session_policy) END,
        'runtime_epoch',COALESCE(pe.epoch,0)) AS facts
    FROM agents a JOIN actors x ON x.agent_id=a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_overrides ro ON ro.agent_id=a.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_policy_epochs pe ON pe.agent_id=a.agent_id
),
endpoint_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.endpoint_id,json_group_array(b.executor_id) AS executors,
        json_group_array(e.kind) AS kinds
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    LEFT JOIN execution_executors e ON e.server_id=b.server_id AND e.executor_id=b.executor_id
    GROUP BY b.endpoint_id
),
runtime_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ep.endpoint_id,json_object('endpoint',json_object('endpoint_id',ep.endpoint_id,'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'workspace_id',ep.workspace_id,'adapter_id',ep.adapter_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'contract_version',ep.contract_version,'profile_id',ep.profile_id,'enabled',ep.enabled,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'health',ep.health,'priority',ep.priority,'selection_group',ep.selection_group,'consumption',ep.consumption,'response_policy',ep.response_policy,'public_config',ep.public_config,'revision',ep.revision),
        'profile',CASE WHEN rp.profile_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('profile_id',rp.profile_id,'adapter_id',rp.adapter_id,'config',rp.config,'secret_refs',rp.secret_refs,'inherit_ambient',rp.inherit_ambient,'enabled',rp.enabled,'revision',rp.revision) END,'represented',json(af.facts),
        'binding_executors',json(COALESCE(eb.executors,'[]')),
        'host_kinds',json(COALESCE(eb.kinds,'[]')),'grants',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(item)) FROM (SELECT json_object('grant_id',g.grant_id,'actor_agent_id',g.actor_agent_id,'credential_binding',g.credential_binding,'represented_agent_id',g.represented_agent_id,'endpoint_id',g.endpoint_id,'workspace_id',g.workspace_id,'profile_revision',g.profile_revision,'actions',g.actions,'expires_at',g.expires_at,'no_expiry',g.no_expiry,'unlimited_actions',g.unlimited_actions,'used_executions',g.used_executions,'max_executions',g.max_executions,'revoked_at',g.revoked_at,'revision',g.revision) AS item FROM runtime_execution_grants g WHERE g.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.actor_agent_id IN (SELECT agent_id FROM actors) ORDER BY g.grant_id)), '[]'))) AS facts
    FROM agent_endpoints ep JOIN agent_facts af ON af.agent_id=ep.agent_id
    LEFT JOIN runtime_profiles rp ON rp.profile_id=ep.profile_id
    LEFT JOIN endpoint_bindings eb ON eb.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
),
recipient_bindings AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT b.binding_id,ep.agent_id,MIN(b.endpoint_id) AS endpoint_id,COUNT(*) AS bindings
    FROM execution_bindings b JOIN execution_installation i ON i.server_id=b.server_id AND i.singleton=1
    JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id GROUP BY b.binding_id,ep.agent_id
),
ranked_leases AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT l.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY l.server_id,l.executor_id,l.session_id ORDER BY l.lease_serial DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_leases l JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
),
source_keys AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT server_id,executor_id,source_operation_id FROM live_requests),
ranked_receipts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT rr.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rr.server_id,rr.executor_id,rr.operation_id ORDER BY rr.receipt_revision DESC) AS position
    FROM execution_receipts rr JOIN source_keys k ON k.server_id=rr.server_id AND k.executor_id=rr.executor_id
        AND k.source_operation_id=rr.operation_id
),
stream_failures AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.server_id,s.executor_id,s.session_id,s.owner_generation
    FROM execution_sessions s JOIN session_keys k USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id)
    JOIN execution_event_watermarks w USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    JOIN execution_event_ingress e USING(server_id,executor_id,session_id,stream_epoch)
    WHERE s.lifecycle_state NOT IN ('CLOSED','FAILED') AND e.event_type='error'
      AND e.sequence<=w.committed_contiguous
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.native_type')='core.event_pump_failed'
      AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.payload.code')='EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE'
)
SELECT json_object(
    'request',json_object('canonical_request_id',r.canonical_request_id,'kind',r.kind,'state',r.state,
        'request_revision',r.request_revision,'stream_epoch',r.stream_epoch,'source_operation_id',r.source_operation_id,
        'received_at',r.received_at,'expires_at',r.expires_at,'scope',json_object('server_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.server_id'),'executor_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.executor_id'),'binding_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_id'),'agent_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id'),'workspace_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_id'),'workspace_binding_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.workspace_binding_id'),'session_id',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.session_id'),'session_owner_generation',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.session_owner_generation'),'authorization_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.authorization_revision'),'configuration_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.configuration_revision'),'binding_revision',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.binding_revision'),'credential_epoch',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.credential_epoch')),
        'method',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.method'),
        'approval_kind',json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.operational_request.params._meta.codex_approval_kind')),
    'approval',CASE WHEN ap.approval_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('status',ap.status,
        'decision_revision',ap.decision_revision,'decided_at',ap.decided_at,'archived_at',ap.archived_at,
        'recipient_agent_id',json_extract(ap.request_payload,'$.kwargs.recipient_agent_id')) END,
    'source',CASE WHEN turn.operation_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('action',turn.action,'actor_agent_id',turn.actor_agent_id,'subject_agent_id',turn.subject_agent_id,'expected_revisions_json',turn.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',turn.admission_state) END,
    'domain_link_exists',x.operation_id IS NOT NULL,'domain_sender',msg.from_agent_id,
    'session',CASE WHEN s.session_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('stream_epoch',s.stream_epoch,'lifecycle_state',s.lifecycle_state,'lease_state',s.lease_state) END,
    'authority',CASE WHEN b.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND ep.endpoint_id IS NOT NULL AND subject.agent_id IS NOT NULL
        AND ex.executor_id IS NOT NULL AND wb.workspace_binding_id IS NOT NULL AND real.realization_ref IS NOT NULL
        AND opening.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND ci.intent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object(
        'lifecycle_state',s.lifecycle_state,'lease_state',s.lease_state,'owner_generation',s.owner_generation,
        'binding_id',s.binding_id,'workspace_id',s.workspace_id,'workspace_binding_id',s.workspace_binding_id,
        'endpoint_id',b.endpoint_id,'binding_revision',b.binding_revision,'binding_workspace_binding_id',b.workspace_binding_id,
        'realization_workspace_binding_id',real.workspace_binding_id,'realization_revision',b.realization_revision,
        'current_realization_revision',real.revision,'realization_status',real.status,'subject_agent_id',real.subject_agent_id,
        'agent_id',ep.agent_id,'protocol',ep.protocol,'activation_state',ep.activation_state,'enabled',ep.enabled,
        'health',ep.health,'workspace_status',wb.status,'kind',ex.kind,'control_state',ex.control_state,
        'generation',ex.generation,'owner_instance_id',ex.owner_instance_id,'revoked_at',ex.revoked_at,
        'api_key_hash',subject.api_key_hash,'is_active',subject.is_active,
        'semantic_payload',json_object('action',json_extract(opening.semantic_payload,'$.action'),
            'payload',json_object('mode',json_extract(opening.semantic_payload,'$.payload.mode'))),
        'expected_revisions_json',opening.expected_revisions_json,'admission_state',opening.admission_state,
        'actor_agent_id',opening.actor_agent_id,'source_guard_digest',ci.source_guard_digest,'actor_guard_digest',ci.actor_guard_digest,
        'dispatch_grant_id',dispatch.dispatch_grant_id) END,
    'revisions',CASE WHEN rev.agent_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('credential_epoch',rev.credential_epoch,'authorization_revision',rev.authorization_revision,'configuration_revision',rev.configuration_revision) END,
    'latest_lease',CASE WHEN latest.lease_serial IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('lease_serial',latest.lease_serial,'status',latest.status,'request_json',latest.request_json,'scope_json',latest.scope_json,'connection_id',latest.connection_id,'connection_generation',latest.connection_generation,'grant_id',latest.grant_id,'source_grant_revision',latest.source_grant_revision,'allowed_actions_json',latest.allowed_actions_json,'applied_at',latest.applied_at,'valid_until_server',latest.valid_until_server) END,
    'previous_lease',CASE WHEN previous.lease_serial IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('lease_serial',previous.lease_serial,'status',previous.status,'request_json',previous.request_json,'scope_json',previous.scope_json,'connection_id',previous.connection_id,'connection_generation',previous.connection_generation,'grant_id',previous.grant_id,'source_grant_revision',previous.source_grant_revision,'allowed_actions_json',previous.allowed_actions_json,'applied_at',previous.applied_at,'valid_until_server',previous.valid_until_server) END,
    'receipt',CASE WHEN receipt.receipt_revision IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('stage',receipt.stage,'receipt_revision',receipt.receipt_revision) END,
    'runtime',json(runtime.facts),'subject',json(subject_facts.facts),'initiator',json(initiator.facts),'operator',json(operator.facts),
    'delegated_runtime',CASE WHEN delegated.facts IS NOT NULL THEN
        json_set(delegated.facts,'$.recipient_binding_count',recipient_binding.bindings) END,
    'contained',containment.session_id IS NOT NULL OR failure.session_id IS NOT NULL,
    'recovering',recovery.agent_id IS NOT NULL AND (recovery.state<>'READY' OR recovery.generation<>ex.generation),
    'lane',CASE WHEN lane.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND ticket.ticket_id IS NOT NULL THEN json_object(
        'state',lane.state,'agent_id',lane.agent_id,'connection_id',lane.connection_id,'connection_generation',lane.connection_generation,
        'bound_connection_id',ticket.bound_connection_id,'revoked_at',ticket.revoked_at,'scopes_json',ticket.scopes_json,
        'authorization_revision',lane.authorization_revision,'configuration_revision',lane.configuration_revision,
        'credential_epoch',lane.credential_epoch,'expires_at',lane.expires_at,'ticket_expires_at',ticket.expires_at) END
) AS facts
FROM requests r
LEFT JOIN approvals ap ON ap.approval_id=r.canonical_request_id
LEFT JOIN execution_operations turn ON turn.server_id=r.server_id AND turn.executor_id=r.executor_id AND turn.operation_id=r.source_operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_domain_deliveries x ON x.server_id=r.server_id AND x.executor_id=r.executor_id AND x.operation_id=r.source_operation_id
LEFT JOIN delivery_outbox d ON d.operation_id=x.domain_operation_id
LEFT JOIN messages msg ON msg.message_id=d.message_id
LEFT JOIN live_requests live ON live.canonical_request_id=r.canonical_request_id
LEFT JOIN execution_sessions s ON live.canonical_request_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id=r.server_id AND s.executor_id=r.executor_id AND s.session_id=r.session_id
LEFT JOIN execution_bindings b ON b.server_id=s.server_id AND b.executor_id=s.executor_id AND b.binding_id=s.binding_id
LEFT JOIN agent_endpoints ep ON ep.endpoint_id=b.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN agents subject ON subject.agent_id=ep.agent_id
LEFT JOIN execution_executors ex ON ex.server_id=s.server_id AND ex.executor_id=s.executor_id
LEFT JOIN execution_workspace_bindings wb ON wb.server_id=s.server_id AND wb.executor_id=s.executor_id AND wb.workspace_binding_id=s.workspace_binding_id
LEFT JOIN execution_realizations real ON real.server_id=b.server_id AND real.executor_id=b.executor_id AND real.realization_ref=b.realization_ref
LEFT JOIN execution_operations opening ON opening.server_id=s.server_id AND opening.executor_id=s.executor_id AND opening.operation_id=s.open_operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_client_intents ci ON ci.server_id=opening.server_id AND ci.actor_agent_id=opening.actor_agent_id
    AND ci.operation_id=opening.operation_id AND ci.intent_id GLOB 'r4intent_*' AND ci.session_selection<>'reuse'
LEFT JOIN execution_dispatch_outbox dispatch ON dispatch.server_id=opening.server_id AND dispatch.executor_id=opening.executor_id AND dispatch.operation_id=opening.operation_id
LEFT JOIN execution_agent_revisions rev ON rev.server_id=r.server_id AND rev.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
LEFT JOIN ranked_leases latest ON latest.server_id=s.server_id AND latest.executor_id=s.executor_id AND latest.session_id=s.session_id AND latest.position=1
LEFT JOIN ranked_leases previous ON previous.server_id=latest.server_id AND previous.executor_id=latest.executor_id AND previous.session_id=latest.session_id AND previous.lease_serial=latest.lease_serial-1
LEFT JOIN ranked_receipts receipt ON receipt.server_id=r.server_id AND receipt.executor_id=r.executor_id AND receipt.operation_id=r.source_operation_id AND receipt.position=1
LEFT JOIN runtime_facts runtime ON runtime.endpoint_id=ep.endpoint_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts subject_facts ON subject_facts.agent_id=subject.agent_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts initiator ON initiator.agent_id=opening.actor_agent_id
LEFT JOIN agent_facts operator ON operator.agent_id='operator'
LEFT JOIN recipient_bindings recipient_binding ON recipient_binding.agent_id=json_extract(r.operational_frame_json,'$.agent_id')
